name: apply a fixed sequence of shrinking elementary steps, choosing each sign by the residual
mechanism: a table holds the angle (or log) of each elementary factor whose tangent (or ratio) is a power of two; step through the table, at each entry rotating or scaling in whichever direction reduces the remaining target, using only shifts and adds; the accumulated direction bits and the residual give the function value

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'CORDIC' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Elementary and special functions: computes hyperbolic and trigonometric functions using a table of arctangents
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'BKM algorithm': computes elementary functions using a table of logarithms

requires: a table of elementary angles or logs (data)
fails_when: one bit of precision per step; a final scale constant
